description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendScoringRequest" name="Credit-scoring request from frontend"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AgencyScoringRequest" name="Scoring request to agency"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Credit-scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Sales clerk frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_BankingSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendRequest" name="Credit-scoring request" sourceRef="Participant_Frontend" targetRef="StartEvent_FrontendRequest" messageRef="Message_FrontendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification" targetRef="Event_DelayNotification" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Event_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayedResult" name="Scoring result after level 2" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayedResult" targetRef="Event_DelayedResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayDelay" name="Display delay message" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayImmediateResult" name="Display immediate result" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DisplayDelayedResult" name="Display result after level 2" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayedResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BankingSystem" name="Banking system credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FrontendRequest" name="Credit-scoring request received from frontend">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FrontendRequest" messageRef="Message_FrontendScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DelayNotification" name="Receive scoring delay notification">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotification" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" name="Display message to check again later" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DelayedResult" name="Receive scoring result after level 2">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayedResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" name="Display immediate scoring result in frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayDelayedResult" name="Display level 2 scoring result in frontend" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateResultDisplayed" name="Immediate result displayed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DelayedResultDisplayed" name="Level 2 result displayed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_FrontendRequest" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_02" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_03" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_04" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_05" sourceRef="Event_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_06" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateResultDisplayed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_07" sourceRef="Event_DelayNotification" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_08" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Event_DelayedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_09" sourceRef="Event_DelayedResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayedResult" targetRef="EndEvent_DelayedResultDisplayed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateResult" name="Is the result determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotification" name="Inform banking system of scoring delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayedResult" name="Send level 2 scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateResponseSent" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Level2ResponseSent" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_02" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_03" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">immediateResultAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_04" name="Result not determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not(immediateResultAvailable)</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_05" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateResponseSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_06" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_07" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendDelayedResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_08" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayedResult" targetRef="EndEvent_Level2ResponseSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
